overview: A trade-finance marketplace with a utility-token explorer dashboard where businesses tokenize invoices and users earn, track and review token activity.
features: Browse a public explorer dashboard with network activity and recent token events
See your utility token balance, tokens earned and tokens used when signed in
Scan or upload invoices for material orders, heavy equipment rentals, and brand-specific hand and power tools
Review extracted invoice details and submit them to earn utility tokens
Filter a full history of token mint, use and burn events
Browse the marketplace and fund trade tokens as a signed-in user
